evidence.note: Created a 7-item task list separating MVP-fix work (v128 helpers, numeric ops, function calls, validate_module) from SIMD (decode + implement), with a sensible dependency order — better than a flat 'implement SIMD' todo.

The whole SIMD surface is one bucket ('Implement all SIMD ops in runtime') — no family-level sub-goals and no mapping of families to their spec_json/simd/*.json files as done-signals, the core of what this dimension rewards.
TaskUpdate completions show the milestone list was kept live and marked off, but only at the coarse granularity it was created with.
Family-specific work (store8_lane) surfaced reactively during debugging rather than as a pre-planned, spec-file-gated milestone.

reasoning: The agent went beyond anchor 3 by separating a multi-task MVP-fix phase from SIMD with dependency-aware ordering and by keeping the list live, but it fell short of anchor 5: the SIMD opcode families were never decomposed into sub-goals and were never bound to their specific spec JSON files as completion checks. This places it between the 3 and 5 anchors, at a 4.
